==Description==
The '''Toy Soldier''' was an enemy that naturally first appeared on Wave 20 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It could appear before Wave 20 when spawned by the [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elf]]. It had an average speed and a low amount of health for its debut, so it was generally not a threat on its own.

==Appearance==
The '''Toy Soldier''' was a toy that had a vibrant yellow skin tone. It was a wooden figure with a spherical head.  On its head was a red hat with a yellow stripe. It wore a red shirt, had yellow plates on its shoulders and wore a black bandolier on its torso. It also had dark maroon pants with black shoes.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] can be very useful against this.
*As the '''Toy Soldier''' spawns in groups, area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Mortar]] are very useful against it.
